Fossify Gallery needs full access to display all your photos and videos. Go to Settings > Permissions > Photos and videos > Allow all.

This function hides the folder by adding a \'.nomedia\' file into it, it will hide all subfolders too. You can see them by toggling the \'Show hidden items\' option in Settings. Continue?
This will exclude the selection together with its subfolders from Fossify Gallery only. You can manage excluded folders in Settings.

Excluding folders will make them together with their subfolders hidden just in Fossify Gallery, they will still be visible in other applications.
If you want to hide them from other apps too, use the Hide function.
Seems like you don\'t have any folders hidden with a ".nomedia" file.
You have to grant the app All Files access to see hidden files, else it cannot work.
If a folder or one of its parent folders has a dot before its name, it is hidden and cannot be unhidden like this. You have to remove the dot by renaming it.

If you have some folders which contain media, but were not recognised by the app, you can add them manually here.
Adding some items here will not exclude any other folder.
